question: How many members’ signatures are required to initiate the impeachment process against the President of India.

options.text: In case of Rajya Sabha i.e. 1/4 members, in case of Lok Sabha 1/3 members
In case of Lok Sabha 100 members, in case of Rajya Sabha 50 members
1/4 members of the impeaching house either Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha
1/3 members of the impeaching house either Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**1/4 members of the impeaching house either Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The procedure of Impeachment of the President of India is the Quasi-Judicial Procedure**.

 
 
• The procedure begins with the introduction of a **bill in either house of Parliament.**
